description: Live EU job-market read for the profile in one of the user's CVs: salary ranges, demand and in-demand skills, from external labour-market data. PRO, daily limit. Use when the user asks what they could earn or how in-demand their profile is.

cvId.description: The id of the CV to use (get it from list_my_takemeup_cvs).

locale.description: Language for results and links (en, de, fr, …). Defaults to the language of the user's TakeMeUp account.

name: run_takemeup_market_pulse
title: Market Pulse for a CV (PRO)
